home.story.region: The meaning behind Mirembe and our story
home.story.meaning: In Ugandan Bantu languages, Mirembe means “peace” or “tranquility” — a hope for harmony, for one person and for the whole community.
home.story.feeling: That’s what we want you to feel when you walk through your door: a calm, clean space and one less thing to worry about.
home.story.meaningAlt: A woman relaxing on a sofa in a peaceful home
home.story.origin: Mirembe Cleaning Company was founded by a husband and wife who are homeowners, multifamily real estate investors, and landlords. Between caring for our own home, our family, and our rental properties, we saw how difficult it could be to find cleaning help that was reliable, efficient, and fairly priced.
home.story.solution: So we built the kind of cleaning company we wanted for ourselves.
home.story.care: As a woman- and minority-owned family business serving Connecticut and Massachusetts, we treat every home with the same care we’d give our own. Whether it’s a rental between tenants, a busy family’s home, a parent who needs a little extra help, or someone experiencing health or mobility challenges, our goal is to make life a little easier.
home.story.welcome: When you choose Mirembe, you’re not just hiring a cleaning company. You’re welcoming a family that cares.

faq.opening.question: When does Mirembe Cleaning Company open?
faq.opening.answer: We open for regular bookings in January 2027. We’re also accepting a limited number of holiday cleanings in November and December 2026.
faq.areas.question: What areas do you serve?
faq.areas.answer: We serve Greater Hartford, Connecticut, and Greater Boston, Massachusetts, including the communities shown above. Join the waitlist if your town is not listed so we can keep you updated.
faq.cleanTypes.question: What’s the difference between a Standard Clean and a Deep Clean?
faq.cleanTypes.answer: A Standard Clean keeps your home fresh and tidy. A Deep Clean includes detailed work like the inside of the oven, microwave, and fridge; baseboards; cabinet fronts; door frames; grout; ceiling fans; and blinds. We recommend a Deep Clean for your first visit or before a big gathering.
faq.products.question: What products do you use?
faq.products.answer: We plan to use carefully selected eco-friendly cleaning products, with fragrance-free options for sensitive households. Let us know about any product preferences when booking.
faq.supplies.question: Do you bring your own supplies?
faq.supplies.answer: Our team arrives with the supplies needed for your clean. If you have product preferences or a particular surface that needs special care, please tell us when booking.
faq.trust.question: Are your cleaners insured and background-checked?
faq.trust.answer: Our cleaning team is planned to consist of trained, background-checked employees, with insurance and bonding for added peace of mind. Please confirm the current coverage and hiring details with us before booking.
faq.access.question: Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
faq.access.answer: You can tell us your access preferences when booking. We’ll coordinate the details with you before your appointment.
faq.guarantee.question: What if I’m not happy with my clean?
faq.guarantee.answer: Let us know within 24 hours if something was missed and we’ll return to re-clean the affected areas at no cost. We’ll confirm the guarantee terms before your appointment.
faq.cancellation.question: What is your cancellation policy?
faq.cancellation.answer: Please contact us as early as possible if your plans change. We’ll confirm the cancellation terms and any applicable fees before your appointment.
faq.schedule.question: Do you clean on weekends and holidays?
faq.schedule.answer: Weekday appointments are planned, with limited weekend and holiday availability when needed. Available times are confirmed during booking.
faq.landlords.question: Do you work with landlords and property managers?
faq.landlords.answer: Yes. Our rental turnover and move-in/move-out service is designed for landlords, property managers, tenants, and homeowners. Ask us about photo reports and volume pricing for five or more turnovers a year.
